_comment: CockroachDB Cloud managed MCP server config, matching the Cloud Console's Connect > MCP dialog. Copy into your MCP client config (Claude Code: .mcp.json; Cursor: mcp.json), replace <your-cluster-id> with the cluster id from that dialog, then authenticate via the OAuth flow the client starts (browser opens; pick read-only). Useful judge trick: ask your MCP-connected editor 'show the facts table in the unforgettable database' and watch the agent's beliefs, provenance included.
